description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler class, testing various device info, status, permissions, and health functions within an Android environment using Robolectric.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the DeviceHandler class, verifying device info retrieval, status, permissions, and health checks.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests the handleDeviceInfo method for returning consistent device information.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Validates the shape and content of the device status payload.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks the structure and granted/denied status of device permissions.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Verifies that partial SMS permissions are treated as granted when send is granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Verifies that partial SMS permissions are treated as granted when read is granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsNoSmsGrantAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures no SMS permissions are granted results in a denied overall status.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsDisabledSmsAsDenied
methods.description: Checks that disabled SMS feature leads to denied permissions.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_marksCallLogUnpromptableWhenFeatureDisabled
methods.description: Ensures call log permission is marked as denied and unpromptable when feature is disabled.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies device health payload contains expected fields with valid values.

methods.name: appContext
methods.description: Provides application context for tests from Robolectric environment.

methods.name: parsePayload
methods.description: Parses JSON payload string into JsonObject.
